gold_note: Alvarezsaurian time tree. The parvicursorine ladder (steps 10-15 px, colour changing along the stems) was checked at 2x; Albinykus leaves the last node at the height where its stem enters, between Ondogurvel and Xixianykus, so that node is a three-way split. The open circles carry no names and the drawings are not part of the tree. Replacement for pol2022a_fig6 (seed 20261117). 23 tips, 1 polytomies (3 children). Random-sample case (seed 20261114).
